calls.title: Pricing
calls.summary: The team discussed refining the pricing model to address the challenges of balancing flat-rate discounts and usage-based pricing, aiming for consistency and clarity across product tiers. Dan Wathne proposed a flat 10% discount compared to Statsig’s pricing, introducing floor and ceiling pricing for platform fees. A debate regarding warehouse native access for Pro tier ensued, highlighting Jeremy's stance on its necessity for Pro customers. An analysis revealed that average spending for Pro customers could face significant increases under new models. The target for Pro customers was clarified as small teams running fewer than 50 experiments per year. Additionally, a competitive pricing audit is planned to benchmark GrowthBook against similar vendors while also modifying sales strategies to better align packages.
calls.keywords: pricing strategy, warehouse native, pro plan, enterprise plan, per experiment pricing, sales enablement
